name: task_update
description: Edit an existing task card. To change the bash body, pass `old_string` + `new_string` — these behave exactly like the `edit` tool on core/tasks/<name>.sh (exact-string replacement; must appear once unless `replace_all=true`). Metadata fields (`description`, `check_interval`, `progress`, `comments`) are full-replace when passed.

name.description: Name of the task card to update.

old_string.description: Exact substring to replace in the card's bash script. Must appear once unless replace_all=true.

new_string.description: Replacement text for the bash script edit. Pair with `old_string`.

replace_all.description: If true, replace every occurrence of old_string in the script. Default false.

description.description: New description for the task (full replace).

check_interval.description: New cadence in seconds between script runs (must be > 0).

comments.description: Updated comments/notes on the task (full replace).
